nbaInjuries.name: Anthony Edwards
nbaInjuries.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

nbaInjuries.name: Stephen Curry
nbaInjuries.note: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Paolo Banchero
nbaInjuries.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
nbaInjuries.note: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Brandon Ingram
nbaInjuries.note: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

nbaInjuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
nbaInjuries.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

nbaInjuries.note: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Ajay Mitchell
nbaInjuries.note: Mitchell (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.
